{{nihongo|'''Ikohaya Wakimikoto Shrine'''|伊去波夜和氣命神社（石巻市水沼）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].
